scripts.text: According to the design drawing, this part is connected to the central room... But I only see a suspicious gate.
scripts.translation: 根据设计图，这里应该连接中央房间...但我只看到一道可疑的门。

scripts.text: No wonder it looked like they had something to back them up.
scripts.translation: 难怪看起来他们有所依仗。

scripts.text: Shall we use an explosive and blow it up?
scripts.translation: 要不要用炸药把它炸开？

scripts.text: Not in such a crude way!
Well, I made a great decision when I came here.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我来这里真是个明智的决定。

scripts.text: I asked him whether he knows the paths here, and his answer was yes. So I brought him here.
scripts.translation: 我问过他认不认识这里的路，他说认识，所以我就把他带来了。

scripts.text: He will activate the gate to the central room.
scripts.translation: 他会启动通往中央房间的门。

scripts.text: Hmm, I see. That's the way to operate it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我明白了。原来是这么操作的。

scripts.text: And we don't need him anymore.
Really? Then I will bring this researcher to the squadron outside.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？那我把这名研究员带到外面的队伍那里。

scripts.text: About the central room, {0} I am counting on you!
scripts.translation: 中央房间的事就拜托你了，{0}！

scripts.text: Haha, they let us open the gate of the central room!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，他们允许我们打开中央房间的门了！

scripts.text: Please speak to me again once you are ready to go in here.
scripts.translation: 准备好进入这里时，再来跟我说话。

scripts.text: After activating the gate, we have to guard it from outside.
scripts.translation: 门启动后，我们得在外面守着。

scripts.text: So I cannot go in there with you.
^4d4dffThis event is proceeded to the Memorial.
Please try again after organizing a party.^000000
If you are entering now, I will activate the gate.
scripts.translation: 如果你现在要进去，我就启动门。

scripts.text: We both know that we don't have time for this, don't we?
scripts.translation: 我们都知道没时间磨蹭了，对吧？

scripts.text: Wow! This is it! I always learn things quickly!
scripts.translation: 哇！就是这样！我学东西一向很快！

scripts.text: We have found a strange phenomenon in the central room. We are not investigating it.
scripts.translation: 我们在中央房间发现了奇怪现象，目前正在调查。

scripts.text: Perhaps there was a strong experimental subject left inside.
scripts.translation: 也许里面还留着强大的实验体。

scripts.text: What kind of facility is this?
Once it is identified appropriately, I might ask you for a settlement ...
scripts.translation: 等确认情况后，我可能会请你处理一下...

scripts.text: I will have to guard the gate of the central room again.
scripts.translation: 我得再次去守中央房间的门了。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThis event is proceeded to the Memorial.
Please try again after organizing a party.^000000
If there is a gate that has already been activated, you can see it.
scripts.translation: 如果门已经启动，你就能看见入口。

scripts.text: Otherwise, please ask your party leader for entrance.
scripts.translation: 否则请找队长带你进入。

scripts.text: If you are entering now, I will activate the gate.
scripts.translation: 如果你现在要进去，我就启动门。

scripts.text: We both know that we don't have time for this, don't we?
scripts.translation: 我们都知道没时间磨蹭了，对吧？

scripts.text: Wow! This is it! I always learn things quickly!
scripts.translation: 哇！就是这样！我学东西一向很快！

scripts.text: We are not sure how many more experimental subjects are there that were made and abandoned by that Eisen Werner guy.
scripts.translation: 不知道那个艾森·维尔纳还制造并遗弃了多少实验体。

scripts.text: But let's call it a day.
^4d4dffMD Only the party leader can enter [Central room] now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff记忆副本[中枢室]目前仅限队长进入。^000000

scripts.text: You can move to the central room.
Oh ... I have to turn it on every time. It's so inconvenient!
scripts.translation: 哦...每次都得重新启动，真麻烦！

scripts.text: The gate is malfunctioning now. It's dangerous like this ...
scripts.translation: 门现在故障了，这样很危险...

scripts.text: Honestly, I'm impressed. I never expected you would come all the way here.
scripts.translation: 说实话，我很佩服你。没想到你真的能一路来到这里。
欢迎来到艾森·维尔纳的世界。

scripts.text: I never imagined that it would be done all of a sudden like this.
scripts.translation: 我从没想过一切会突然变成这样。

scripts.text: I've given up saving this laboratory anyway.
scripts.translation: 反正我已经放弃拯救这座实验室了。

scripts.text: Would you like to take a look?
There were many things, including cracks in dimensions, etc.
scripts.translation: 这里发生过许多事情，包括次元裂缝等等。

scripts.text: In some worlds, the flow of time is twisted.
scripts.translation: 有些世界的时间流动是扭曲的。

scripts.text: Or has someone been to a certain point in the past?
scripts.translation: 还是有人回到了过去的某个时间点？

scripts.text: What does time mean? Have you ever thought about it?
scripts.translation: 时间意味着什么？你想过这个问题吗？

scripts.text: If time goes biologically, it means someone gets older.
scripts.translation: 如果时间按生物规律流动，人就会变老。
那个人的时间被强行停止了。

scripts.text: In that case, we use an expression such as this.
scripts.translation: 这种情况我们会用这样的说法。

scripts.text: Would you like to take a look inside?
Take your time and look through the corridor.
I sent the silly guys back to start over.
scripts.translation: 我把那些笨蛋送回去重新开始了。

scripts.text: Well, it wasn't easy at all.
If only that kid had gone back, he would not have ended that way...
scripts.translation: 要是那孩子能回去，就不会落得那种下场...

scripts.text: I mean, if only he stopped...
scripts.translation: 我是说，要是他停下来就好了...

scripts.text: The chairman... I mean, that person is obsessed with the past.
scripts.translation: 理事长...我是说，那个人对过去着了迷。

scripts.text: Thanks to the chairman, I can do my research as I want.
scripts.translation: 多亏理事长，我才能随心所欲地做研究。

scripts.text: Why is he so obsessed with the past?
scripts.translation: 他为什么那么执着于过去？

scripts.text: By the way, you have to operate the instruments on the right and left if you want to go beyond this.... Can you do it?
scripts.translation: 对了，想继续前进就得操作左右两边的装置...你会吗？

scripts.text: Since it's a simple device, I guess you can.
scripts.translation: 装置很简单，我想你应该会。
再把^4d4dff蓝色^000000换成^ff0000红色^000000。就是这样。

scripts.text: If you looked at my work properly, you'll understand what I am saying.
scripts.translation: 只要仔细看过我的研究，就会明白我在说什么。

scripts.text: Then I'll see you in the next zone.
scripts.translation: 那么我们在下个区域见。

scripts.text: There are security codes written down.
Seems like there is one more security device.
scripts.translation: 好像还有一个安全装置。

scripts.text: The next security devices are similar, so I won't have to explain again.
scripts.translation: 接下来的安全装置也差不多，我就不再解释了。

scripts.text: After looking around here, what do you think?
scripts.translation: 参观这里之后，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: That is the laboratory I built by referring to it.
scripts.translation: 我参考那里建造了这座实验室。

scripts.text: The technology was completely different from what we'd had until then.
scripts.translation: 那里的技术和我们当时掌握的完全不同。
我们已经用上了所有可用的东西。

scripts.text: Do you wonder why I'm saying these things?
scripts.translation: 你想知道我为什么这么说吗？

scripts.text: Hmm, that's because you're going to die here anyway.
scripts.translation: 嗯，反正你就要死在这里了。

scripts.text: So I would like to promote my achievements.
scripts.translation: 所以我想向你展示我的成就。

scripts.text: Do you think I am just stupid enough to be left here alone?
scripts.translation: 你以为我会蠢到独自留在这里吗？

scripts.text: I know you've come here for the affair of Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation: 我知道你是为了卢恩-米德加尔特王国的事来到这里。
所以我准备了一些东西。
你会死在这里。就在这里。

scripts.text: Let's move to the next zone.
Beyond this wall, there will be something you have come to obtain.
scripts.translation: 这面墙后面有你们此行要找的东西。

scripts.text: Right. That thing you carved into a gem and used as a decoration on the crown.
scripts.translation: 没错，就是你们把它雕成宝石、镶在王冠上的那件东西。

scripts.text: Do you even know what it is?
Although it is a scrap, it's the heart fragment of Ymir.
scripts.translation: 虽然只是一块碎片，但它是伊米尔之心的碎片。

scripts.text: It cannot be compared to an imitation.
scripts.translation: 仿制品根本无法与它相提并论。

scripts.text: ... The fools in the kingdom cannot even utilize the power they already have.
scripts.translation: ...王国里那些蠢货，连已有的力量都不会利用。

scripts.text: So I decided to use it...
You want to reclaim it? It's all up to your capability.
scripts.translation: 想把它夺回去？那就看你们有没有本事了。

scripts.text: I haven't been waiting with empty hands.
scripts.translation: 我可没有空手等着你们。

scripts.text: Let me tell you once again. Don't be surprised.
scripts.translation: 我再说一遍，别被吓到了。

scripts.text: No, I'd be glad if you were surprised.
scripts.translation: 不，你们要是被吓到我反而会很高兴。

scripts.text: Now, take a look at the gift I've prepared.
scripts.translation: 现在看看我准备的礼物吧。

scripts.text: You have two choices in the next zone.

If you want to replay the story of Seyren Windsor, please select ^4d4dffProceed with the story^000000. If you want to see the masterpiece of Eisen Werner, please select ^4d4dffProceed with the battle^000000.
scripts.translation: 想重温赛依连·温莎的故事，请选择^4d4dff继续故事^000000。想欣赏艾森·维尔纳的杰作，请选择^4d4dff继续战斗^000000。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffOnly the party leader can proceed with this event.^000000
- Cannot progress with quest because you have too many items in your possession. -
scripts.translation: - 由于您持有的物品过多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text: This place is the core of the laboratory, and contains everything of my research.
scripts.translation: 这里是实验室的核心，保存着我研究的一切。

scripts.text: It is the heart fragment of Ymir that holds the fundamental power to constitute the world. It also holds the origin of life.
scripts.translation: 这就是伊米尔之心的碎片，蕴含构成世界的根本力量，也是生命的起源。

scripts.text: What you've come to reclaim is doing something marvelous!
scripts.translation: 你们想夺回的东西，正在创造奇迹！

scripts.text: The energy extracted from this flows into the magic circle on the ground... Ha ha ha. Of course, this magic circle has been reinterpreted magically.
scripts.translation: 从中提取的能量流入地上的魔法阵...哈哈哈。当然，这个魔法阵经过了魔法改造。

scripts.text: In any case, the energy goes into the experimental subject... Using that power, I've adjusted their time.
scripts.translation: 总之，能量会进入实验体...我利用这股力量调整了它们的时间。

scripts.text: ... Certainly, some of them get killed due to chapped cells. Ha ha!
scripts.translation: ...当然，有些实验体会因为细胞干裂而死。哈哈！

scripts.text: Is that all you want to say?
scripts.translation: 这就是你想说的全部吗？

scripts.text: Have you already forgotten what I told you earlier?
scripts.translation: 你已经忘了我刚才说的话吗？

scripts.text: I told you I'd prepared a gift.
How do you like the gift I've prepared?!
This fellow was among the delegation of that silly royal family.
scripts.translation: 这家伙是那群愚蠢王族代表团的一员。

scripts.text: Thanks to the experiment of some brave guy, I have obtained this great stuff.
scripts.translation: 多亏某个勇敢家伙的实验，我才得到这件宝贝。

scripts.text: Are you talking about the In Vivo Experiment?
Well, there are plenty guys who do In Vivo Experiments apart from that fellow, but he was the first one brave enough to enhance a living creature.
scripts.translation: 进行活体实验的人不止他一个，但他是第一个敢于强化活体生物的人。

scripts.text: using the imitated heart fragment of Ymir
scripts.translation: 他使用的是仿制的伊米尔之心碎片

scripts.text: It was a great turning point for the In Vivo Experiments.
scripts.translation: 这成为活体实验的重要转折点。

scripts.text: I was trying to apply it to many kinds of stuff.
scripts.translation: 我正试着把它应用到各种实验中。

scripts.text: You should say hello to it. Right?
scripts.translation: 你应该跟它打声招呼，对吧？

scripts.text: You don't need to say hello, because both of you are going to die!
scripts.translation: 不用打招呼了，因为你们两个都要死！

scripts.text: Seyren, escort these guests to hell.
scripts.translation: 赛依连，送这些客人下地狱。

scripts.text: Do you understand what I am saying?
scripts.translation: 你听明白我说的话了吗？

scripts.text: What is this, Seyren? Is it a negative phase now?
scripts.translation: 怎么了，赛依连？你现在是处于低潮期吗？

scripts.text: I feel like I've woken up from a long sleep.
scripts.translation: 我感觉自己像是从漫长的沉睡中醒来。

scripts.text: Maybe it was for this day.
Do not forget your duty, Seyren.
scripts.translation: 别忘了你的职责，赛依连。

scripts.text: You are a weapon. You are nothing more than a puppet with the outfit of a knight called Seyren Windsor.
scripts.translation: 你是武器。你不过是一个穿着骑士服装、名叫赛依连·温莎的人偶。

scripts.text: Do you need me to explain step by step?
scripts.translation: 需要我一步一步解释吗？

scripts.text: After transplanting the dummy of Ymir's Heart, the body could not endure the power and eventually collapsed.
scripts.translation: 移植伊米尔之心的仿制品后，身体无法承受那股力量，最终崩溃了。

scripts.text: Then its spirit duplicated the main body and kept dividing over and over.
scripts.translation: 随后它的灵魂复制本体，不断分裂。

scripts.text: During that process, its memory, consciousness, soul, mind and ego were all scattered like sand. They became meaningless.
scripts.translation: 在这个过程中，它的记忆、意识、灵魂、心智和自我都像沙子一样散落，失去了意义。

scripts.text: When we transplanted the dummy of Ymir's Heart into someone with a strong mind and body, we expected that person would become a stronger biological weapon.
scripts.translation: 我们把伊米尔之心的仿制品移植给身心强健的人，本以为能造出更强的生物武器。

scripts.text: We never expected that it would duplicate itself and divide endlessly. As a result, that experiment was regarded as a failure.
scripts.translation: 我们没想到它会自我复制并无限分裂，因此那次实验被视为失败。

scripts.text: To make things worse, it was an uncontrollable creature that was filled only with fury.
scripts.translation: 更糟的是，它成了只剩愤怒、无法控制的生物。

scripts.text: You know what? They are still dividing now.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗？它们现在还在分裂。

scripts.text: Just imitating the main body, they are even growing inside it.
scripts.translation: 它们只是在模仿本体，甚至还在本体内部成长。

scripts.text: Since they are imperfect beings now, they want to become perfect.
scripts.translation: 它们如今是不完美的存在，所以想变得完美。

scripts.text: They are imperfect beings now, so they want to become perfect, rather than just imitating the main body and living as a virtual image.
scripts.translation: 它们如今是不完美的存在，想要变得完美，而不只是模仿本体、作为虚像存活。

scripts.text: They wish to exist as a singular entity.
scripts.translation: 它们渴望作为独立个体存在。

scripts.text: And the only successful experiment is you. We call you Seyren now.
scripts.translation: 而唯一成功的实验体就是你。我们现在称你为赛依连。

scripts.text: ...... Is it the end of your will?
Hey, baby? You can't do this to me.
scripts.translation: 喂，小子？你不能这样对我。

scripts.text: Don't you remember how much I struggled to bring you here out of that hell?
scripts.translation: 你不记得我费了多大力气才把你从那个地狱里带出来吗？

scripts.text: Do not be swayed by the consciousness of someone who's already dead.
scripts.translation: 别被一个已死之人的意识动摇。

scripts.text: Let me ask you again. Is it the end of your will?
scripts.translation: 我再问你一次，你的意志到此为止了吗？

scripts.text: Isn't this world a funny place? Ha ha ha ha ha
scripts.translation: 这世界真有趣，不是吗？哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Never think that I'm finished here.
I don't need a loser either.
... Eisen. You have abandoned everything like this.
Now, I have a much more urgent message for you rather than for Eisen.
scripts.translation: 现在，我有比对艾森更紧要的话要告诉你。

scripts.text: I've been waiting for you for a long time.
As Eisen said, it's no longer important whether I'm Seyren or not.
scripts.translation: 正如艾森所说，我是不是赛依连已经不重要了。

scripts.text: Since I had the ability to think, I didn't know who I was nor why I existed.
scripts.translation: 自从拥有思考能力以来，我就不知道自己是谁，也不知道为何存在。

scripts.text: The continuous division created countless copies of myself.
scripts.translation: 不断分裂创造出了无数个我的复制体。

scripts.text: The power entwined with the dummy of Ymir's Heart, which responded to my will and that of my companions. They wanted to unite, but kept dividing themselves over and over.
scripts.translation: 仿制的伊米尔之心蕴含着力量，它回应了我和同伴们的意志。我们渴望合而为一，却不断地反复分裂。

scripts.text: How many copies of myself have been created so far?
scripts.translation: 到现在为止，究竟产生了多少个我的复制体？

scripts.text: I lost the ego after continuous division, but was regenerated as the previous shape. I don't think it was a coincidence.
scripts.translation: 不断分裂让我失去了自我，却又以原来的形态再生。我不认为这只是巧合。

scripts.text: I thought there must have been a reason.
scripts.translation: 我想这一切必定有原因。

scripts.text: And I realized it after looking at ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000.
scripts.translation: 看过^4d4dff泰拉格罗利亚^000000后，我终于明白了。

scripts.text: The reason why the god gave me this opportunity.
scripts.translation: 明白了神赐予我这个机会的原因。

scripts.text: Have you come to reclaim this?
... The land is gone and only the star remains.
scripts.translation: ...大地已不复存在，只剩下星辰。

scripts.text: Eisen is right. ^4d4dffSeyren Windsor is no longer in this world.^000000
scripts.translation: 艾森说得没错。^4d4dff赛依连·温莎早已不在这个世界上。^000000

scripts.text: All I have now is the strong will to transfer something on and on.
scripts.translation: 如今我只剩下不断传递某种事物的强烈意志。

scripts.text: Maybe that bit of will made me exist.
scripts.translation: 也许正是这份意志让我得以存在。

scripts.text: I really don't have more time.
scripts.translation: 我真的没有多少时间了。

scripts.text: After this moment, ^4d4dffI will be divided and scattered.^000000 again.
scripts.translation: 从这一刻起，^4d4dff我又将分裂、消散。^000000

scripts.text: While I still have my will now, I have one message to give you.
scripts.translation: 趁我还保有意志，我有一句话要告诉你。

scripts.text: Seyren Windsor, the knight of Prontera failed in the task.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉骑士赛依连·温莎未能完成任务。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffMe and all my companions died long ago.
Please don't waste your affections on the bodies that are already dead.^000000
scripts.translation: 请不要把感情寄托在已经死去的躯体上。^000000

scripts.text: They are just like ghosts covered with peels.
scripts.translation: 他们只是披着外壳的幽灵。

scripts.text: I was lucky to show my last will in front of you.
scripts.translation: 我很幸运，能在你面前表达最后的心愿。

scripts.text: They are ^4d4dffrelics^000000 of me and my companions.
scripts.translation: 这些是我和同伴留下的^4d4dff遗物^000000。

scripts.text: Please give them to our families.
scripts.translation: 请把它们交给我们的家人。

scripts.text: It was great to see you at the end.
scripts.translation: 很高兴能在最后见到你。
